claimCeiling: Conditional theory, application-specific synthesis and constructed examples; priority unresolved.

claims.name: Discount sensitivity
claims.statement: The duration-effort difference is the negative log derivative of relative normalised recovery, multiplied by 1+r.
claims.closestPriorWork: Discounted weighted-average calculus; Kozack (2005) motivates discount sensitivity, not the proof.
claims.conditions: fixed flows; common flat rate r>-1; positive PVs
claims.evidence: Written differentiation proof; exact financial examples

claims.name: Affine/quadratic reduction
claims.statement: Fixed old claims and affine new flows give two affine tests and one quadratic duration test on each regime.
claims.closestPriorWork: Standard positive-denominator clearing; specialised to the declared three comparisons.
claims.conditions: fixed old denominators; nonnegative flows; positive PVs on bounded rational closures

claims.name: Exact finite method
claims.statement: Face-stationary enumeration suffices to minimise a quadratic on a bounded rational polytope, including singular stationary systems.
claims.closestPriorWork: Classical facewise stationarity; a direct self-contained proof is supplied, no new general optimiser claimed.
claims.conditions: bounded nonempty polytope; exact feasibility for each affine stationary set

claims.name: Endpoint failure
claims.statement: A constructed stream can pass duration strictly at both endpoints and fail on an interior interval despite lower payments at every date.
claims.closestPriorWork: The mechanism is weighted-average timing; priority of this exact example is unresolved in the bounded search.
claims.conditions: specified rational streams and discount factors
claims.evidence: Symbolic proof; input-bound exact polynomial; strict eta=1/8 regression; figure

claims.name: Payment-removal diagnostic
claims.statement: Duration falls exactly when the removed stream has a later discounted mean date than the original; the covariance and downward-closure formulas follow.
claims.closestPriorWork: Elementary weighted-average algebra; application-specific consequence for a duration veto.
claims.conditions: fixed old claims/reference; positive discount factors; residual PV>0

claims.name: Complete payment interval
claims.statement: A nonnegative scalar payment has a feasible interval that can include a strictly positive floor.
claims.closestPriorWork: Intersection of affine half-lines, with timing-specific financial coefficients.
claims.conditions: fixed comparator and payment direction; positive denominators
claims.evidence: Proof; 100 varied models, 4100 comparisons and two floor cases

claims.name: Information constraint
claims.statement: A finite payment selected from observed information is feasible exactly when every nonempty observation class has finite supremum floor no greater than its infimum cap.
claims.closestPriorWork: Scalar specialisation of adjustable robust optimisation and nonanticipation.
claims.conditions: nonempty observation classes; sup floor finite; any additional measurability/expressibility restrictions stated separately
claims.evidence: Interval-intersection proof; floor and multi-regime examples

claims.name: Sharp cap and sensitivity
claims.statement: In the specified early-upside example, separate zero-tolerance screens cap p at 8; value alone permits 6410/441; the stated weighted rule permits about 11.842053.
claims.closestPriorWork: Contract-specific calculations using established metrics; caps/floors are not new instruments.
claims.conditions: specified constructed contracts; 5% for numeric value/weighted comparisons; separate cap8 also has all-discount proof
claims.evidence: Exact polynomial/caps and continuous sensitivity brackets

claims.name: Joint-trigger and information example
claims.statement: The constructed two-variable four-date contract has six reachable regimes and sharp observable policy p(u)=8+2 1[u>=1/2].
